analysis.task_statement: The user asked why multiple CI jobs on PR #2056 were hanging at the "Setup Keyring" step in GitHub Actions, having seen it before take hours or need a cancel/rerun. The session diagnosed the root cause (apt-get update stalling on an Ubuntu mirror, with no job timeout so jobs ran to the 6h default) and determined the keyring step was no longer needed. The user then asked for the fix to be opened as a PR, and finally asked that an explanatory comment block the assistant had added to the workflow be removed.
